title: Vehicle-speed signal was lost
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM had detected vehicle speed and then lost the speed-sensor signal.
failureCriteria: The previously detected vehicle-speed signal disappears.

likelyCauses.cause: Intermittent connection at the vehicle-speed sensor or PCM
Harness damage, including heat damage near the exhaust

falsePositiveConditions: An intermittent connector can imitate a failed speed sensor.
confirmatoryTests: Watch the vehicle-speed reading while safely reproducing the condition.
Inspect and gently move the sensor and PCM harness connections.
Inspect harness routing near hot exhaust components.
